issues.detail: The skill is implemented in Node.js, limiting cross-platform compatibility.

scenarios.name: extract-design-tokens
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items (fetch, retry, parsing, typing) but omits the required geometry=paths query; Response B is incomplete and lacks all required functionality.

scenarios.name: export-asset-png
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully meets the rubric: correct API call, proper handling of null URLs, correct file naming, and use of node:fs/promises; Response A fails to name files correctly and does not properly log null URLs.

scenarios.name: figma-webhook-file-update
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully meets the rubric with correct endpoint, payload fields, and a timing-safe passcode check; Response B uses the wrong API endpoint, incorrect payload structure, and a non-timing-safe passcode comparison, failing to satisfy the rubric.
